For the left-hand side, we have

$$
{{field-2}}={{field-3}}

and for the right-hand side, we have

$$
{{field-4}}={{field-5}}.
$$

Thus, our statement is {{field-6}} for $n=1.$

{{field-8}}={{field-9}}.
